name: Homogeneity-Based KD-Tree Construction
aliases: AMR Mesh Construction via Homogeneity-Based KD-Tree
definition: A hierarchical data structure for AMR datasets that avoids the memory waste and performance penalty of homogeneous page tables by grouping same-level cells into patches and building a KD-tree based on level homogeneity.
summary: Homogeneity-Based KD-Tree Construction groups same-level AMR cells into patches to build a tree for efficient CPU-GPU volume rendering, avoiding memory waste from voxel replication.
